title: Milk and Soured Milk (filmjölk) Intervention on Oxidative Stress and Inflammation
brief_summary: This study evaluates a high intake of milk compared with a high intake of soured milk (Swedish filmjölk) on markers of oxidative stress and inflammation in a randomized crossover intervention study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Tolerates both a low and a high intake of milk and soured milk
* Agrees to comply with study protocol

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inflammatory bowel disease
* Major gastric tract operation
* Pregnancy
* Eating disorder
